version_series_meaning: This package is a data-only overlay, and model_card_version names this overlay's own artifacts. The model graph its rows decode through is the one base_weights names, at that package's own model_card_version. Neither number is package_version, which moves in lockstep across every mailwoman workspace on every release.

attribution_recorded_in_another_package.text: HM Land Registry — Price Paid Data (OGL v3.0): the `synth-gb-v1` training extract (800,000 rows) NEW in 6.7.0, and the `pair-index-gb.bin` placetype-pair index (`neural-weights-en-gb`, this same task). Crown copyright, attribution required.

unresolved: No digest is recorded for 8 of 8 declared artifacts: postcode-gb.bin, pair-index-gb.bin, fst-en-gb.bin, fst-street-morphology.bin, anchor-lexicon-v1.json, locality-surface-lexicon-v7.json, street-type-lexicon-v3.json, country-surface-lexicon-v1.json. An unrecorded digest is not a verified one.
This package's model card records no training attribution. That states what the card holds, not that the artifacts have no attributable inputs.

pair-index-gb.bin ships here, and the entry attributing it sits in @mailwoman/neural-weights-en-us's model card. A consumer installing this package alone receives the artifact without the attribution.

Which records trained the model this package ships or inherits is unresolved. No frozen per-release training manifest exists, and the corpus named above is the recipe's corpus rather than a record of what reached the model.
